title: Evaluation of an LLM in Identifying Logical Fallacies: A Call for Rigor When Adopting LLMs in HCI Research
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation and benchmarking of GPT-4's performance in identifying logical fallacies. While it mentions principles of trustworthy AI and includes a single example of a logical fallacy involving religious belief in the appendix, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
